words.definition: an area of short, mowed grass around a house or building
words.example: The landscaping crew mows the office lawn every Friday.
words.exampleTranslation: 園藝團隊每週五都會修剪辦公室的草坪。

words.definition: an instrument used to view very small objects that are invisible to the naked eye
words.example: The lab technician examined the sample under a microscope.
words.exampleTranslation: 實驗室技術員用顯微鏡檢查樣本。

words.definition: to give someone a false impression or wrong idea
words.example: The ad was pulled because it could mislead customers about the price.
words.exampleTranslation: 這則廣告因為可能誤導顧客對價格的認知而被下架。

words.definition: to put something somewhere and then be unable to find it
words.example: She misplaced the signed contract somewhere on her desk.
words.exampleTranslation: 她把簽好的合約放錯地方，在桌上找不到了。

words.definition: a small stall or booth that sells newspapers and magazines
words.example: There's a newsstand right outside the train station entrance.
words.exampleTranslation: 火車站入口外面就有一個報攤。

words.definition: the ongoing operating costs of running a business, such as rent and utilities
words.example: Moving to a smaller office reduced our monthly overhead significantly.
words.exampleTranslation: 搬到較小的辦公室大幅降低了我們每月的營運成本。

words.definition: a collection of work samples, or a set of investments held by a person or company
words.example: Please bring a portfolio of your previous design work to the interview.
words.exampleTranslation: 請帶你之前的設計作品集來面試。

words.definition: a frame or stand for holding or displaying items
words.example: New arrivals are displayed on the rack near the front window.
words.exampleTranslation: 新到貨的商品展示在靠近前窗的架子上。

words.definition: to change the structure or design of a building
words.example: The store will be closed next week while we remodel the entrance.
words.exampleTranslation: 下週我們要翻修入口，商店會暫時休息。

words.definition: numerical data collected and analyzed to show facts or trends
words.example: The quarterly statistics show a steady rise in online sales.
words.exampleTranslation: 季度統計數據顯示線上銷售穩定成長。

words.definition: an underground passage, often for a road, railway, or pipeline
words.example: The delivery was delayed because the tunnel was closed for repairs.
words.exampleTranslation: 因為隧道封閉維修，這批貨延誤了。

words.definition: without any limit or restriction
words.example: The premium plan offers unlimited access to all training videos.
words.exampleTranslation: 高級方案提供無限制觀看所有訓練影片的權限。

words.definition: a substance found in food that is essential for good health
words.example: The cafeteria menu now highlights meals rich in vitamins.
words.exampleTranslation: 自助餐廳的菜單現在會特別標示富含維生素的餐點。

words.definition: a place where animals are kept for public viewing
words.example: The company outing this year will be a trip to the zoo.
words.exampleTranslation: 今年的公司員工旅遊會去動物園。

words.definition: watchful and quick to notice things; also used as a noun for a warning notification
words.example: Staff should stay alert for any unusual activity near the loading dock.
words.exampleTranslation: 員工應該對裝卸區附近任何異常活動保持警覺。

words.definition: a large room or building used for public gatherings, performances, or speeches
words.example: The keynote speech will be held in the main auditorium.
words.exampleTranslation: 主題演講將在主禮堂舉行。

words.definition: a famous person, especially in entertainment or sports
words.example: A local celebrity was invited to open the new store.
words.exampleTranslation: 新店開幕邀請了一位當地名人剪綵。

words.definition: to subtract an amount, especially from a total sum of money
words.example: The shipping fee will be deducted from your refund.
words.exampleTranslation: 運費會從你的退款中扣除。

words.definition: an interruption that prevents something from continuing as normal
words.example: The system upgrade may cause a brief disruption to online ordering.
words.exampleTranslation: 系統升級可能會讓線上訂購短暫中斷。

words.definition: a person whose job is to install or repair electrical systems
words.example: We hired an electrician to fix the wiring in the warehouse.
words.exampleTranslation: 我們請了一位電工來修理倉庫的電線。
